title: Board View column header shows grip, avatar, name, pin and count as designed
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design pictures "DC-10-board-column-headers-light-1440.png" and "DC-10-board-pinned-light-1440.png" attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and rank numbers in the pictures are sample data.
  • Four technicians are active at {Location-A} with the "Technician" role: {Technician-A}, who has a profile photo, {Technician-B}, who has none, {Technician-C} and {Technician-D}. No technician is pinned in your Board View.
    For example: {Technician-A} to {Technician-D} are ZZAUTOTEST C590119 Lea, Max, Nia and Oli.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has Approved work orders {Work-order-1} led by {Technician-A} and {Work-order-2} led by {Technician-B}, and an Estimate {Work-order-3} with no lead technician.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C590119 Column Header, and {Work-order-1} to {Work-order-3} are S10043-17827 to S10043-17829.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Board View" shown, the name of {Customer-A} in "Search", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off, density "Regular".
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the "Unassigned" column header from left to right.
  2. Look at {Technician-B}'s column header from left to right.
  3. Look at the avatar in {Technician-A}'s column header.
  4. Click the pin in {Technician-B}'s column header.
  5. Look at the pin in {Technician-B}'s column header.
  6. Click the pin in {Technician-A}'s column header.
  7. Click the pin in {Technician-C}'s column header.
  8. Hover the pin in {Technician-D}'s column header.
  9. Click the pins of {Technician-B}, {Technician-A} and {Technician-C} to unpin them.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: a round light-grey avatar with a grey outline person icon, the word "Unassigned" in dark semibold text, a short grey divider, a clipboard outline icon and the count. No grip and no pin, as in the picture.
  • Step 2: the six-dot grip, a light-grey circle with the initials in dark grey (a little darker than in the design picture, not a solid blue circle with white initials), the name in dark slate semibold text, a grey outline pin, a short divider, the clipboard icon and the count.
  • Step 3: the avatar is the technician's round photo.
  • Step 4: {Technician-B}'s column moves to just after "Unassigned".
  • Step 5: the pin is a pin with a slash through it, in blue, as in the pinned picture.
  • Step 6: {Technician-A} is pinned too.
  • Step 7: {Technician-C} is pinned too; three technicians are pinned.
  • Step 8: the pins on the unpinned columns look faded and the hover text reads "You can pin up to 3 technicians."
  • Step 9: every technician column header shows the grey outline pin again.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; stories SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View), SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 61 (16 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S3-R12, S2-R23, S3-R7, S3-R8 and S1-R9a, read 16 Oct 2026. Claude Design project "Work Orders" (Branko Cicovic), export of 14 Oct 2026, board "Work Orders.dc.html" (the design pictures named in the preconditions were rendered from it), read 14 Oct 2026. Related tickets: SV-11319, SV-11338. Source-verified 16 October 2026. Last checked against build v26.40.17-a5c4210 (staging) on 10/15/2026, before the expected results changed on 16 Oct 2026; the changed results have not yet been checked against a build.

SV-11338 estimates the design's header name at about 16 px; the ticket's estimated design sizes differ from the design file, which draws the name at 14 px semibold; this case follows the design file. The design allows five pins; this case follows the PRD's limit of three.

PRD versions 55 and 58 (S2-R23) set no-photo initials to a darker grey than the design file (#4B5565 instead of #697586, for contrast) and header names slate semibold; step 2 checks it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R12: “Each column header shows the technician’s name, avatar, and a count of the work orders currently shown in that column, after the filter view and filters are applied, so the count always matches the cards listed.”
  • S2-R23: “In Tech View and Board View, as in the design: a technician avatar without a photo is a light-grey circle (--sv-grey-100, #EEF2F6) with initials in --sv-grey-600 (#4B5565) in light mode, which meets accessible contrast (6.7:1; the design file’s #697586 is 4.2:1); dark mode uses the design’s dark colors; group and column header names are 14px, weight 600, in the design’s slate text color (#364152), with the design’s smaller, lighter initials; Board card customer and total price are weight 500; toolbar and switcher icons are the design’s slate color (the switcher in List too, S1-R9a). Technician avatars, and the Service Advisor avatar, follow density in Tech View as in the design: 20px, 24px and 32px on rows and 24px, 28px and 36px on group headers at Compact, Regular and Comfortable; Board View card avatars stay 24px. The Progress bar is 48 by 4px at Compact, as in the design. The name bubble on hover over a technician avatar on a row or card (the +N included) opens above the avatar, in both views; group and column header avatars keep the browser’s plain name tip, because the name is printed beside them. In Tech View, Status, Waiting On Parts and Progress are left-aligned. The Density and Columns tooltips open above their button, like the switcher’s (S1-R9b), and are hidden while their menu is open. List is unchanged.”
  • S3-R7: “Allow users to pin a technician from the column header.”
  • S3-R8: “At three pinned technicians, disable other pin controls with: “You can pin up to 3 technicians.””
  • S1-R9a: “The switcher uses the design’s icons at 20px: List is Lucide `list`, Tech View is `user-round`, Board View is `square-kanban`. In Tech View and Board View these icons are the design’s: density (`row-height` in Tech View, `card-height` in Board View, custom icons in the design system’s icon set), collapse chevron (`chevron-down`), pin and unpin (`pin` / `pin-off`), Invoiced or Paid lock (`lock`), Unassigned avatar (`user-round`) and the empty state when there are no work orders at all (`clipboard-list`). The filtered no-results state is the List’s, magnifier included (S1-N1). The filter chips and Search use the design file’s icons in every display option, List included, each exactly as the design file draws it. The display switcher (new on every view, List included) shows the design’s slate icons in every view, so it keeps one color as the user moves between views. These are the only changes to List. Every other List icon is unchanged.”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, Board View Unassigned avatar: “width: 28px; height: 28px; flex: none; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--sv-surface-sunken); color: var(--sv-text-secondary);”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, Board View column header name: “font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--sv-text-primary); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; margin-right: -8px;”
  • Design — _ds_bundle.js (design library), staff avatar without a photo: “background: color || 'var(--sv-surface-sunken)', color: color ? 'var(--sv-accent-on-solid)' : 'var(--sv-text-secondary)',”
